name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: Toggle and ToggleGroup backed by Base UI with single/multiple selection, controlled state, vertical orientation, spacing, and variant/size controls.

files.content:
type allowedPrimitiveT = string | number | boolean

type optionT = {
  label: React.ReactNode
  value: allowedPrimitiveT
  className?: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

type groupT = {
  group: string
  options: (allowedPrimitiveT | optionT)[]
  className?: string
}

type optionsT = (allowedPrimitiveT | optionT | groupT)[]

type indicatorAtT = 'right' | 'left'
